name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare
description: A template for deploying MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth authentication and SSE transport. Demonstrates how to create remote MCP servers that can be accessed by Claude Desktop and other MCP clients over HTTP.
